newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston trust files for $250 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston trust files for $250 mln debt.

text.p: A business trust formed by BankBoston Corp filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in floating rate capital securities.

The trust, known as BankBoston Capital Trust III, will use proceeds to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of BankBoston. The corporation intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes.
The capital securities have a liquidation amount of $1,000 per security, the filing said.
